package example.bankwealth.v2.domain.entities.behaviors

import example.bankwealth.v2.domain.entities.CreditBalanceEntity._

object CreditBalanceEventHandler extends EventHandler {
  override def apply(state: State, input: Event): State = input match {
    case event: FundsReserved =>
      state.copy(
        availableAmount = (state.availableAmount - event.amount),
        reservedTotal = (state.reservedTotal + event.amount),
        reservedByTx = state.reservedByTx.updated(event.txId, event.amount)
      )
  }
}
